summary: Rows 190-196 open season 10 (en-WP: eps 190-205 = chapters 286-315, vols 32-35, with only 204/205 filler) and run CONTIGUOUSLY from ch 286 p.9 to ch 299 with no skip and no reorder — the un-cross-cut shape of the 152-165 block is gone here, because Kubo himself is cross-cutting only two threads (Ichigo/Nnoitra-Nelliel and Renji-Uryu/Szayelaporro) and Pierrot animates them in the manga's own order. bleach.fandom's page-level 'chapters' fields partition the two shared chapters exactly once each (286: ep 167 p.1-8 + ep 190 p.9-21; 292: ep 192 p.1-8 + ep 193 p.9-19), animefillerguide's chapter column gives the same chapter SET on all seven rows, the fandom volume pages reverse-map vol 32 -> eps 165-167 & 190, vol 33 -> eps 190-194, vol 34 -> eps 195-199, and TV Tokyo's own archived per-episode synopses (あにてれ back-number list, eps 189-200) describe exactly that manga content row by row. Seven anchors delivered (287 -> 299), all high, inside the stored fence (167 -> 286, 203 -> 315). The two stored 'mixed' rows both come apart under the 2026-09-02 clauses: ep 190's entire non-source share is a 15:08 CLIP-SHOW recap of ch 178 onwards (fandom Trivia + AFG's timestamp note agree), which counts for NOTHING in the standing (T28 recap clause, the FotNS 130 witness) — the remainder is a full adaptation of 286 p.9-21 + 287, so the row is canon; ep 193 has no anime-original story block in ANY source (AFG types it plain canon, TV Tokyo's synopsis is pure ch 292-293, the fandom summary is pure manga), only an expanded fight/flashback stretch of 30 pages across a full episode, which the faithfulness clause keeps canon. Both are proposed as type corrections with divergence annotations; AFL (and its derivative bleachfiller.com, the same list) is the only dissent. The ~1-minute 'Shinigami Illustrated Picture Book' / 'Arrancar Encyclopedia' gag corners are on EVERY row in the block, including the five AFL-canon ones, so they cannot be the mixed reason and are not material under T28.

anchors.note: after a 15:08 recap (re-shown pages, never cited) the episode continues exactly where ep 167 stopped: 286 'Guillotine You Standing' p.9-21 (Grimmjow cut down by Nnoitra) + 287 'Don't Forget Till You Die' in full (Nnoitra reveals he is the Quinta; Renji/Uryu loop back into Szayelaporro's chamber). START 286 by A10 — 13 first-time pages, not a sliver, and 'pages, not numbers' makes them a real position even though 286 was already ep 167's END (A4/A10). Volume from the END chapter (287 opens vol 33)

ch 288 'THE BAD JOKE' (Szayelaporro releases Fornicaras, the carbon-copy fluid) + 289 'The Scarmask' (Ichigo overpowered by Nnoitra) — fandom field and AFG's set agree exactly; TV Tokyo's synopsis for 第191話 describes both beats (A4)

ch 290 'Unleash The Beast' + 291 'Thank You For Defend Me' + the first 8 pages of 292 'Rupture My Replica'; ends mid-292 (ep 193 opens at p.9). A47 does NOT hold the END back: the tail is 8 pages, above the 5-page bar and with no teaser wording, so the END advances to 292 and a partial names the split. The fandom Qref index independently pins ch 291 p.14 / p.17-19 to episode 192 (Nelliel's Gamuza / Nelliel pages)

ch 292 p.9-19 (the clones multiply; Uryu spots the differences; Renji's bankai wrecks the lab) + 293 'urge for unite' in full (Teatro de Titere — the voodoo dolls of Uryu and Renji). START 292 by A10 (11 leading pages). The fandom Teatro de Titere page carries three Qref citations 'chapter=293|page=7-9 / 11 / 14-15|episode=193', a page-level reverse index for this exact row (A4)

ch 294 'IF YOU CALL ME BEAST, KILL YOU LIKE TEMPEST' + 295 'The Last Mission' — Nnoitra's Espada-era duels with Nelliel and the ambush that cracked her mask; closes vol 33, and the fandom vol-33 page reverse-maps the volume to 'Episodes 190 - 194', which terminates this row exactly. TV Tokyo's 第194話 synopsis is the same flashback (A4)

ch 296 'Changed Again And Again' (Nelliel's Gamuza / Lanzador Verde, then the reversion to child form) + 297 'KING OF THE KILL' (Pesche's Ultima, the Cero Sincretico); opens vol 34, whose fandom page reverse-maps to 'Episodes 195 - 199'. The Lanzador Verde page pins 'chapter=296|page=6-9|episode=195' (A4)

ch 298 'INTRUDERZ3' (Kenpachi cuts Tesra down; the Gotei 13 captains come through the stabilised Garganta) + 299 'The Verbal Warfare' (Unohana/Rudbornn and Byakuya/Zommari face off). Block terminal — the next row (197, another agent's) opens at ch 300 'Curse Named Love' on both fandom and AFG, so the handoff is clean and the upper fence 203 -> 315 is untouched (A4)

continue_points.note: ends mid-292 'Rupture My Replica' (p.8); ep 193 opens at 292 p.9 — resume INSIDE 292 (C1)

FENCE-ROW ADDITION (ep 167 has an END anchor but no continue): ep 167 stops at 286 p.8 and the next 22 rows are the Amagai filler arc, so the reader who stops there resumes INSIDE ch 286 (p.9), which is where ep 190 restarts (C1 — the stored ep-127 -> 229 shape across the 128-137 filler). Not a repair: no continue value is stored for this row today

annotations.note: ch 286 'Guillotine You Standing' is split in RUNNING order across the 22-episode Amagai filler arc: ep 167 animates p.1-8 (its field says so verbatim), ep 190 animates p.9-21 after its recap. Each page appears exactly once. Labelled partial rather than rearranged because nothing is out of order — the split is a straddle of the filler block (the ep 127/138 -> ch 229 shape, which the store labels rearranged because ep 138 REOPENS with it)

the first 15:08 of ep 190 is a clip-show recap of the Arrancar arc from ch 178 onwards — already-animated material, re-shown, so it is never cited and moves no position (T28 recap clause, Sean 2026-09-02; the FotNS 130 witness: a recap's SIZE never makes a row mixed). fandom Trivia: 'The first fifteen minutes of this episode recap the events following Aizen's defection... covering chapter 178 onwards. The episode then continues on from where episode 167 ended.' AFG prints the same fact as a timestamp: 'we only watch from the 15:08 mark to the end'

ch 292 'Rupture My Replica' is split exactly once: ep 192 takes p.1-8 (the tail of a 46-page row), ep 193 takes p.9-19. Both fandom fields state the page ranges; A47 does not apply (8 pages > the 5-page bar, no teaser wording), so ep 192's END is 292 and ep 193's START is 292

the stored/AFL 'mixed' label is not supported by any source that names content: AFG types the row plain canon, TV Tokyo's official synopsis (第193話) describes only ch 292-293 beats, and the fandom summary is wholly manga. What the episode does is STRETCH 30 pages over a full episode (vs 46 pages in ep 192) — expanded clone-fight action and an extended recall of Nelliel's Espada appearance that leads into ch 294 — which the faithfulness clause keeps canon

every row in the block closes with a ~1-minute anime-original gag corner — 'Shinigami Illustrated Picture Book' (190, 191, 192, 194) or 'Arrancar Encyclopedia' (193, 195, 196). They sit on the five AFL-canon rows as well as the two AFL-mixed ones, so they cannot explain either mixed label, and they are not a story-carrying share under T28. Recorded once for the block; they move no position

type_corrections.note: T28 recap clause: the ONLY non-source content is the 15:08 clip-show recap of ch 178 onwards, which counts for nothing in the standing; the remainder adapts 286 p.9-21 + 287 in full and nothing else. Stored mixed follows AFL; AFG's own 'mixed' note gives the recap as the sole reason ('the first few minutes of the episode are just a recap of previous events'), and the fandom Trivia says the same. en-WP's season-10 article names only 204 and 205 as filler in eps 190-205

no source names an anime-original story block: AFG types the row plain CANON (it flags 190 in the same table, so this is an independent judgment, not a copy of AFL), TV Tokyo's archived 第193話 synopsis is pure ch 292-293 (clones, Uryu's tell, Renji's bankai escape, Fornicaras' new technique), and the fandom summary + page-level field give 292 p.9-19 + 293 with the Teatro de Titere Qrefs confirming ch 293 p.7-15 -> ep 193. The non-source share is pacing stretch and an extended flashback recall, which the faithfulness clause keeps canon (T28: mixed needs a substantial, story-carrying original share). AFL and its derivative bleachfiller.com print identical lists and are ONE source

structure.notes: ROW IDENTITY: all seven rows join on TITLE and AIR DATE across bleach.fandom (japair), animefillerlist and TV Tokyo's あにてれ back-number list (190 = 2008-10-14 ... 196 = 2008-11-25) — no offset anywhere in the block (R20). SEASON SCOPE: en-WP 'Bleach season 10' = eps 190-205, 'the rest of the 32nd volume to the 35th volume (chapters 286-315)', filler = 204 and 205 only. CHAPTER SPACE: the manga's own 1-479 WSJ numbering, the space our stored anchors already use. VOLUME BOUNDARIES (the context stores none above v32; both en-WP's chapter list and the fandom volume pages agree): vol 32 = 279-286 (+ gaiden -16), vol 33 = 287-295, vol 34 = 296-305. REVERSE MAP (fandom volume pages' 'episodes' field, independent of the episode pages): vol 32 -> 'Episodes 165 - 167, 190 & 239', vol 33 -> 'Episodes 190 - 194', vol 34 -> 'Episodes 195 - 199' — each terminates my block's rows exactly where the anchors do. PAGE PARTITION (the trust condition): only two chapters are shared, and each is split exactly once with no gap and no double count — 286 = 8 (ep 167) + 13 (ep 190) = 21; 292 = 8 (ep 192) + 11 (ep 193) = 19. NO REORDER and NO SKIP in this block: 286 p.9 -> 299 runs strictly forward, so unlike 152-165 there is no rearranged annotation and only one mid-chapter continue (192). HANDOFF: my last row is 196 (END 299); ep 197 'Byakuya's Bankai, the Quiet Anger' opens at ch 300 'Curse Named Love' on both bleach.fandom and AFG — the w11b agent's first row picks up there, and the upper fence 203 -> 315 is unaffected. LOWER FENCE: unchanged at ep 167 -> 286; ep 190's START is the same chapter NUMBER by design ('pages, not numbers'), not a regression. AFL/AFG are ONE source on TYPES for this series' block only in the sense that both are filler sites — but here they DISAGREE (193), so AFG's type column is not a copy here; bleachfiller.com, by contrast, prints AFL's exact canon/mixed/filler lists and is a derivative, cross-check only.

flags_for_sean: TYPES 190 and 193: both stored mixed on AFL's authority; I propose canon for both. 190 is the clean recap-clause case (AFG's own note gives the 15:08 recap as the whole reason). 193 is the weaker of the two — no source names ANY anime-original content, but AFL's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' is unexplained rather than contradicted. If you prefer to keep 193 mixed on the AFL label, the anchor (292 p.9-19, 293 -> END 293) is unchanged either way; only the type and the divergence annotation move.

Ep 167 continue (286): delivered as an ADDITION on a fence row that is not one of my targets — it has an END anchor and no stored continue, and it ends mid-chapter (286 p.8) in front of a 22-episode filler arc. Drop it if you want the block kept strictly to 190-196; nothing else depends on it.

Annotation vocabulary on the ch-286 straddle: I used `partial` (a page split in running order, the ep 218/219 shape). The closest stored precedent, ch 229 across the 128-137 filler, is labelled `rearranged` (eps 127/138). If you want the two to match, this one becomes rearranged — no anchor changes.

Volume boundaries for v33 (287-295) and v34 (296-305) are new information relative to the context (which stores only v28-v32); they are two-source (en-WP chapter list + fandom volume pages) and feed the `volume` field on all seven anchors.
